name: Beta Evo trials
engine: 125 to 300 cc liquid-cooled two- or four-stroke single
intro: Beta's trials bikes. Light, low and hard on clutches; most are premix two-strokes.

B: Most Evo trials bikes are two-strokes that run premix. The 300 SS four-stroke uses engine oil instead. Check which one you have.

recallNote: Off-road and trials models are often not in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a dealer for the make to run the frame number.
